sources.entry: Test-Driven Development with Node, Postgres and Knex

summary.title: Test Driven Development with Node, Postgres, and Knex (Red/Green/Refactor)
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a RESTful Express API backed by Postgres via Knex, writing Mocha/Chai tests first and following the red/green/refactor cycle for each route.
takeaways: Set up an Express app, Postgres databases for development and test, and Knex migrations and seeds.
Write failing Mocha/Chai/chai-http tests first, then add query and route code to make them pass (red/green/refactor).
Use beforeEach and afterEach to roll back and re-seed migrations so tests stay isolated from each other.
Build GET all, GET single, POST, and PUT routes using the same test-then-implement pattern.
summary.summary: The article walks through building a RESTful TV shows API with Node, Express, Knex and PostgreSQL using test-driven development. It covers project setup with express-generator, creating development and test databases, Knex config, migrations and seed files, and Mocha/Chai/chai-http setup. Each route is developed by writing a failing test, adding a queries module and route to pass it, then refactoring, with the test database reset via beforeEach/afterEach hooks. The page ends partway through a PUT refactor where changing the id in an update is tested.
